## Objectives

During this session we will:

- Explore the cohort dataset
- Practice descriptive data analysis
- Practice data manipulation and visualization

We start by importing the data from the previous session.

```{r initial settings, results='hide'}
# Import libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(tableone)
library(here)
```

```{r import data}
cohort <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "cohort_baseline.csv"))
```
